name: Grocery List
description: A Todoist project as a touch grocery list: tap to check off, × to remove, add with the on-screen keyboard or 'Add again' chips. Filter by label to make one block per store (IGA, Costco…).
author: Tanya

defaultConfig.staples: Milk, Eggs, Bread, Bananas, Apples, Cheese, Yogurt, Butter, Coffee, Dog food, Cat litter

title.title: Title
title.description: Leave empty to use the store label (or the project name).

projectName.title: Todoist project
projectName.description: Exact name of the Todoist project that holds the list.

labelFilter.title: Only show labels
labelFilter.description: Comma-separated Todoist labels, e.g. IGA or Costco. Items added from this block get the first label. Leave empty to show the whole project.

includeUnlabelled.title: Also show items with no label
includeUnlabelled.description: Handy for a catch-all block, e.g. the store you shop at most.

storeLabels.title: Store choices
storeLabels.description: Comma-separated store labels offered when adding an item. The block's own label is pre-selected.

staples.title: Staples
staples.description: Comma-separated, optional store after @ — e.g. Milk@IGA, Paper towels@Costco. Shown as one-tap Quick add buttons with things you've bought lately.

groupByStore.title: Group by store
groupByStore.description: Split the list into one section per store (from Store choices), each with its own Add button.

storeColors.title: Store colours
storeColors.description: Store:colour pairs for the section headings, e.g. IGA:#16a34a, Costco:#e31837

hideEmptyStores.title: Hide empty stores
hideEmptyStores.description: Leave out store sections with nothing on the list.

featuredStore.title: Double-height store
featuredStore.description: This store is twice as tall as the others (two grid rows). Empty = all the same size.

secrets.label: Todoist API token
secrets.description: Todoist → Settings → Integrations → Developer → API token.
